newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stocks expected to stay range bound.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stocks expected to stay range bound.

text.p: Singapore shares were expected to stay range bound on Tuesday in the absence of fresh market moving factors, dealers said.

"Market sentiment has picked up slightly. And there has been some light bargain hunting of blue chips like Keppel. But most funds are still not really convinced the Singapore market can sustain so the volume is not really there," said a broker with a Singapore firm.
On Monday the Straits Times Industrial index closed up 12.37 points at 2,028.60, but was off the day's highs.
Electronics-based Uraco came under pressure Monday on news auditors of CAM International Holdings (Cam), in which Uraco had a 6.3 stake, had sent a report to the Finance Ministry.

Later on Monday, the Stock Exchange of Singapore made the report public. The report suggest possible violations of the companies act and criminal breach of trust by certain Cam officers. Cam could not be reached immediately for comment.
